title: THE ULTIMATE BETRAYAL
tags: the culture war with tim pool
description:
SCOTUS hears arguments on Trump’s push to end birthright citizenship, with justices signaling skepticism.
The case could determine whether children born in the U.S. to non-citizen parents are granted citizenship, a precedent that has stood for over a century.
A final decision is expected later this year, with major implications for immigration law and constitutional interpretation in the United States.
